description:
Read the persisted structured analysis summary for a file session. Returns { analysis } where analysis is the AnalysisSummary written by analyze_file (page count, trim size, classification, color palette, and recommended file-derived selections), or null when the file session carries no stored analysis.

Use this on a fresh product-page arrival to decide whether to open with a file summary and offer to match the configuration. Absence of a summary means "no analysis → start from scratch".

fileSessionId.description: File session ID to read the stored analysis from.

name: get_file_session_analysis
